1. Identify entities from visual model and audio transcript: Coach (UserConsumerWeb), Member (UserConsumerMobile), Amazon Cognito (Cognito), Amazon Chime SDK (Chime), Amazon API Gateway (ApiGateway), AWS Lambda (Lambda), Amazon Aurora (Aurora), Amazon DynamoDB (DynamoDB), Amazon Kinesis (Kinesis), and Amazon S3 (S3).
2. Establish authentication flow (Flow 0): Member and Coach authenticate via Cognito, then query class metadata through API Gateway and Lambda from Aurora.
3. Establish real-time session flow (Flow 1): Member and Coach establish bidirectional streaming using Chime SDK for video/audio and WebSocket heart-rate telemetry.
4. Establish analytics pipeline (Flow 2): Second-by-second heart rate telemetry streams from Member device into Kinesis and persists into S3 Data Lake.
5. Establish workout summary persistence flow (Flow 3): Completed workout summary is sent via API Gateway REST API to Lambda and written to DynamoDB for mobile app retrieval.

graph.name: Orange Theory Fitness - OT Live Architecture
graph.notes: OT Live uses AWS Chime SDK for low-latency live video and WebSocket heart-rate streaming, backed by a serverless AWS backend for scalability.

nodes.name: Coach
nodes.notes: Coach web interface for managing virtual classes and viewing member metrics

nodes.name: Member
nodes.notes: Member mobile application collecting heart rate and streaming video

nodes.name: Cognito
nodes.notes: Authenticates both coaches and members into virtual classes

nodes.name: Chime SDK
nodes.notes: Handles real-time video/audio streaming and WebSocket heart rate communication

nodes.name: Api Gateway
nodes.notes: REST API endpoint for class metadata and post-workout summary ingestion

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Serverless compute processing class information requests and workout summary writes

nodes.name: Aurora
nodes.notes: Relational database holding class schedule and studio info

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: NoSQL database storing completed workout summaries for rapid app retrieval

nodes.name: Kinesis
nodes.notes: Ingests continuous second-by-second member heart rate streaming telemetry

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Data lake bucket storing raw heart rate and class telemetry analytics

edges.notes: Member requests class details via API Gateway
API Gateway triggers Lambda to fetch class data
Aurora supplies class metadata to Lambda
Member streams video/audio and sends WebSocket heart rate data
Chime SDK delivers video tiles and heart rate dashboard to coach
Coach streams live video, demo media, and audio mix via Chime SDK
Member device streams heart rate telemetry per second to Kinesis
Kinesis writes telemetry into S3 data lake
Member posts workout summary via REST API
API Gateway forwards workout summary to Lambda
Lambda stores summary record in DynamoDB
